# Ke (Coco) Zhao

> Software engineer at Amazon (Seattle, WA) who builds trustworthy agentic systems. Leads agent evaluation for a multi-agent customer-service platform and founded the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents governed access to highly sensitive customer data; builds production AI guardrails (prompt-injection defense, PII protection, hallucination monitoring). 6+ years shipping production software, including 4 at Amazon and 2 as co-founder of ForeverBrainTech (acquired 2022); 8 peer-reviewed papers, 249+ citations, h-index 8. BA Computer Science & Cognitive Science, University of Pennsylvania (Magna Cum Laude, 2022); MS Cybersecurity in progress at NYU Tandon (Cyber Fellow).

## What she builds
An agent a business can rely on has to be evaluated before it ships, limited to governed access to data, and guarded when something goes wrong. Her work covers all three.

- Evaluate: leads agent evaluation and wrote its strategy and roadmap with a group of engineers and scientists; it is the shared standard for the organization's agent framework. A CI/CD release gate scores each agent against ground truth and blocks it below threshold. In production, a critic agent scores answers in real time and signal models score them offline every day, combined into one reliability score. Red-teaming finds failures before customers do.
- Govern access: founded and launched the MCP server, from first commit to production, with tools and agent skills that give AI agents one secure, governed way to reach highly sensitive customer data. Authentication, fine-grained authorization, rate limiting and data-classification controls are built in. Its reusable framework cut other teams' build time for a new MCP server from two months to two weeks.
- Guard: production guardrails for LLM features, including prompt-injection defense, PII detection and scrubbing at >99.9% accuracy, and hallucination monitoring. Has taken AI products through multiple security reviews.

## Highlights
- Leads agent evaluation and the MCP platform for AI agents working on highly sensitive customer data
- Designed a multi-agent system on Claude (Amazon Bedrock) with MCP and RAG/GraphRAG that cut incident analysis from 3 hours to 3 minutes
- Led 5 engineers to turn a hackathon prototype, winner of the People's Choice Award at an internal hackathon (2025), into a production multi-agent reporting system
- Architected an enterprise data platform processing 60M+ documents a day from 20+ sources at 99.99% uptime, serving 10k+ users at <1s p95 latency across 600k+ daily requests and 100+ downstream teams
- Co-founded ForeverBrainTech and led its software development: 100k+ users across 5 provinces, team grown from 0 to 10+ engineers, acquired by HengNao Tech in 2022
- Mentors 10+ engineers and sets technical direction through design docs and security reviews
- 8 peer-reviewed papers in cognitive neuroscience and NLP, 249+ citations, h-index 8
